note: Rustic MI DNR state forest campground on the banks of the Thunder Bay River, 9 mi SW of Alpena via M-32 and Indian Reserve Rd; the last stretch is a narrow gravel and dirt road. Undeveloped carry-in launch on the north side; pike, bass, walleye and panfish; also reachable by canoe. The 1.5-mile Wah-Wah-Tas-See Pathway starts here, and an ORV/snowmobile trailhead to the Devil's Loop trail adjoins the campground. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 10 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (standard wording, silent on length) (all confirmed, derived -> manual); season now dated: closed Dec 1 - May 1 (opens 05-01, closes 11-30). Type 'rustic', not equestrian; an ORV/snowmobile trailhead adjoins it, but the table says ORV operation between campground and trails 'no' and it is not described as an ORV trail camp.
